description: Build a DMX/Art-Net (or sACN) output chain from a fixture list. For each fixture (rgb, rgbw, par64, movingHead8, movingHead16) creates a Constant CHOP with one named, default-valued channel per DMX slot (prefixed '<id>/<channel>'), inserts pad Constant CHOPs to keep DMX-slot alignment, merges them all into one stream, and drives a dmxoutCHOP (`interface`, `universe`, `netaddress`, `rate`). Returns the container + a JSON report with paths, fixtures, total channels, exposed controls (Universe / Rate / Net Address), and warnings. Per-fixture sliders are NOT auto-exposed — bind individual channels later with bind_to_channel / animate_parameter on op('rig_out')['fix1/r'] etc.

fixtures.description: Ordered list of fixtures (sorted by startChannel at build time).

id.description: Constant CHOP name + channel-name prefix; must be a valid TD name.

profile.description: Fixture profile — drives channel count, names, and default values.

startChannel.description: 1-based DMX slot of the fixture's first channel (1–512).

host.description: Target IP for Art-Net / sACN (maps to dmxoutCHOP `netaddress`). Null = leave default.

name.description: Base name for the container COMP.

net.description: Network protocol — written to the dmxoutCHOP `interface` par.

parent_path.description: COMP to create the DMX rig container in (default '/project1').

universe.description: DMX universe written to the dmxoutCHOP.

name: create_dmx_fixture_pipeline
title: Create DMX fixture pipeline
